question: N. Rangasamy sworn in as the Chief Minister of Puducherry in May 2021. What is the name of the party he formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**All India NR Congress**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• N. Rangasamy is the founder and leader of the **All India NR Congress** (AINRC).
 
• The All India NR Congress was formed by N. Rangasamy in **2011** after he split from the Indian National Congress.
 
• The AINRC has a significant political presence in the Union Territory of Puducherry, India.
 
• Under his leadership, the AINRC won the Puducherry Legislative Assembly elections in 2011 and 2021, making Rangasamy the Chief Minister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naam Tamilar Katchi (NTK)**

 
 
• A Tamil nationalist party in the state of Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• It was founded by Senthamizhan Seeman, a Tamil film director, actor, and politician.
 
• The party's ideology is based on Tamil nationalism and the promotion of the Tamil language and culture.
 
 
 
• **Amma Makkal Munnettra Kazagam (AMMK)**
 
 
• A political party in Tamil Nadu founded by T. T. V. Dhinakaran in 2018.
 
• The party was formed after a split within the All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK).
 
• The party's name honors the late Chief Minister Jayalalithaa, who was popularly known as "Amma".
 
 
 
• **Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK)**
 
 
• A political party in Tamil Nadu founded by Thol. Thirumavalavan.
 
• The party primarily represents the Dalit community and advocates for their rights and social justice.
 
• VCK has been active in various social and political movements aimed at empowering marginalized communities.
